changes:
Report the macsmc battery's own time estimates, including at a zero instantaneous rate, with the rate-based estimate as fallback (aurora-silicon/upower).
Upstream bb7af5f1 and a6d72c77: expose the composite KbdBacklight object only while a keyboard backlight device is present.
Upstream c2e6e110: destroy the keyboard backlight I/O watch before closing its fd.
Hand a charge limit saved by asahi-scripts' macsmc-battery units to UPower once, before upowerd starts (upower-charge-limit-migrate, as alarm-aurora and fedora-aurora ship it).
notes: patches/ is aurora-silicon/upower d8a24ffc (the sources.json pin) against upstream v1.91.5, one patch per commit with the merges and the GitHub workflow left out; the patched tree is identical to the pinned commit. packaging.patch adds the migration helper and its unit, pulled in by a static upower.service.wants link as on alarm-aurora. Debian's binary package names are kept.
